title: DHC leak: about 19.11 million records, not 19 million customers
what_changed: The plain-language line said 'the data of about 19 million customers'; DHC and the reports count about 19.11 million records (件), not people. Removed an occurred_at time of 09:00 UTC that no source states. Added Business+IT (18 Nov): PLAID told DHC of the intrusion on 13 November, login passwords were not included, and DHC plans a joint report with PLAID to the Personal Information Protection Commission.
